prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet village market at dawn. On the far left, an elderly woman in a blue shawl sits on a wooden crate, her posture slumped in early morning fatigue. Beside her, a woven basket overflows with bright red apples, resting securely on the cobblestones. A brown rooster stands next to the basket, its head tilted as it looks at a stray grain near the woman's worn boots. In the center foreground, a young boy in a striped shirt points eagerly toward a stack of clay pots, his arm extended in excitement. The potter, a man with soot-stained hands, stands behind the clay pots, smiling gently as he watches the child's gesture. To the right, a black cat sleeps curled atop a burlap sack, completely undisturbed by the waking world. A merchant in a green vest leans against a stall post, holding out a copper coin to a customer in a grey coat who reaches to take it. Behind them, a white goat ties loosely to a railing, chewing rhythmically on a piece of rope. A bicycle with a rusted frame leans against the stall's edge, its wheel slightly bent. There is no electric lighting visible in the scene. There is no modern signage or plastic packaging present. The soft wash of pale yellow suggests the rising sun, while the pencil lines define the textures of wood, fabric, and stone with delicate precision. The interaction between the merchant and customer feels transactional yet warm, contrasting with the solitary rest of the cat and the quiet observation of the rooster. The boy's energy injects life into the stillness, bridging the gap between the seated elder and the standing potter. Every element, from the rough texture of the burlap to the smooth curve of the clay, is rendered with careful attention to detail, ensuring each of the ten distinct entities remains clearly identifiable within the composition.
